title: Featuring a video
summary: Beacons is a free, all-in-one platform with the best link in bio, media kit builder, online store and email marketing tool for creators on Instagram + Tiktok
body_markdown:
Trying to add some more personality to your Beacons page? You can embed a YouTube or TikTok video right onto the page.


1.


[Sign in](https://beacons.ai/signin) and go to the **Featured Video** section under the drop-down menu (or click[here](https://beacons.ai/account?defaultTab=youtubeVideos) )


2.


Turn the video toggle switch on and enter a YouTube or TikTok link:


Your video will be at the top of your page by default, but you can move it around by clicking "Change featured video position." Here's an example with a TikTok video:


**Tips**


-


Record a video introducing yourself or explaining your Beacons page to visitors. This is a great way to drive attention to certain parts of your page, for example your[Store](https://blog.beacons.ai/your-beacons-digital-store/) , your[Support Form](https://blog.beacons.ai/enabling-visitors-to-support-your-content/) , your[Request Form](https://blog.beacons.ai/intro-to-video-requests/) , or certain links


-


If you create content on YouTube, add your latest video, or your channel trailer


-


Removing the video is as easy as turning the "On" switch off. Or by saving a blank entry in the text field


-


Integrate a[TikTok video](https://beacons.ai/i/tiktok) on your Beacons page to showcase more familiar, short form content directly on your site to better[make money on TikTok](https://beacons.ai/i/blog/how-to-make-money-on-tiktok-become-an-influencer) !
